n: Raspberry Pi Experiment with the Sense HAT book
t: A free e-book of Sense HAT projects with sensors and an LED matrix.
steps: Find the Experiment with the Sense HAT book on the Raspberry Pi site and download the PDF.
Set up a Raspberry Pi with a Sense HAT.
Ask IT for help if the Pi needs a network.
Try the digital magic 8-ball project first.
Finish with the data logging chapter.
